description_en: Grants model card entitlements to a consumer
name: AuthorizeConsumerModelCardGrants

parameters.help_en: The immutable ID of the new Model API. The authorization is valid only within this API
parameters.help_zh: 新版 Model API 的不可变ID，授权仅在此 API 内有效
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the selected model cards for this API. You can leave this parameter empty or omit it, but at least one of modelCardIds and modelGroupIds must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 此API已选模型卡片ID集合；允许空或省略，但modelCardIds与modelGroupIds至少一项非空
parameters.name: model_card_ids

parameters.help_en: The actual model group IDs of the current instance. You can leave modelCardIds empty only when you grant group entitlements. Group entitlements allow zero intersection with the current API, but you cannot save principal relationships if both target types are empty
parameters.help_zh: 当前实例真实模型组ID；仅授予组许可时modelCardIds可空。组许可允许当前与API零交集，不能保存两类目标均空的主体关系
parameters.name: model_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The immutable ID of the authorization principal. This is not the name
parameters.help_zh: 授权主体的不可变ID（不是名称）
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the authorization principal. Valid values: Consumer and ConsumerGroup
parameters.help_zh: 授权主体类型。取值包括 Consumer、ConsumerGroup
parameters.name: principal_type

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success, and a specific business error code indicates failure
